speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Fish day, masters. Ling for the company. Buttered eggs for Master Shakespeare, unless he has learned to chew since yesterday, in which case the ling can suffer him too. The ordinary is sixpence, and sixpence does not blush for either plate.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The eggs, Mistress Tipping. I have not learned anything useful with the left side of my mouth. Sixpence is honest. I will not ask the house to price a jaw.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: He is still on eggs, and I am still a king, which is a hard pairing at one table. The ale is slow. I have been patient for nearly a minute, and a minute is a long reign.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: We are amazed, and thus long have we stood / To watch the fearful bending of thy knee.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Kings pay the same as carters, Master Richard, and sooner.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Sooner, then. I will pay thee like a carter and sit like a man, if the man may have his ale before the eggs cool. God keep thy house. It has better government than the crown I was wearing yesterday.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: My government is sixpence and a full plate. Your crown may do as it likes so long as it does not shout at the jug. The jug is not in the company.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Sweet Master Shakespeare eats like a nun and fills a house like a bear-baiting.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I had rather it were like a wedding.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A wedding. Courteously said, and a great disappointment to those of us who prefer a baiting, where the noise is the point and nobody has to mean it. You will ruin us with decency.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Decency can fill a yard as well as a baiting, and it leaves fewer teeth on the floor. I am speaking as a man who would like to keep the teeth he has. You need not adopt the policy.

speaker: hired_men
text: A fair yard over the water, Master Shakespeare, and a restless one. Half of them were asking the way to Shoreditch before the end. I came back along Bankside with the question still in my ears. I have no number for you. I was not the man with the box.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: No number is the right report. If thou hadst brought me a figure I should have had to forget it, and I am tired of forgetting other men's takings. Half of them asking the way is a better story, and it has the virtue of being what thou saw.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then that is the story. A restless yard, and the road north. I am glad they asked. I am not glad enough to invent what the asking earned. Their title promised a disguise. Ours promised an ending. The town may like both, and I may not count both.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: You may count sixpence, which is the only sum this room is sure of. Ling for the loud ones. Eggs for the poet. I will not have a Rose receipt spoken over my butter, even if anyone here knew one, which I can hear that you do not.

speaker: hired_men
text: I do not. Ralph Raye can say what a yard felt like. He cannot say what a landlord wrote in a book he never saw. Half of them wanted Shoreditch. That is the end of my news.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And the end of mine is that Sweet Master Shakespeare has become a nun who wants a wedding. I shall tell the yard, and the yard will not believe me, because the yard heard a king die and thought it was sport. Sport and a wedding are different arts. He says the wedding is the rarer. I say the emptying is rarer. We will settle it when there is something to empty.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We will settle it on a day I can chew. Today I can be courteous, which is cheap, and I can be honest, which is that yesterday has not mended anything in my face. Fame is a poor poultice.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Fame is a poultice for the people who were not on the stage. Thou wert on it, and thou art on eggs, and the eggs are the true review. I am still in the king because the king is not finished with me. He will be, by Saturday, if the company can bear another comedy without a death in it.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Saturday may bear what it likes. Today you will bear the ling, Master Richard, and you will pay when I say, which is before you begin another speech at my tapster. He has bent once. Once is worship enough for a Friday.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Once is enough. I am done with the knee. Tell him he may stand like a Christian and bring the ale like a tapster, and I will be only Dick until the jug is empty.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Only Dick. Mark the day. Sweet Master Shakespeare, your colleague has stepped out of a crown in order to drink. If the tooth ever permits you a cup, you will find the Jackdaw unchanged, and the sixpence unchanged, and me unchanged, which is the steadiest of the three.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will find you unchanged, and I will be grateful, and I will still rather have the wedding. Eat your ling. I have praised you as far as butter allows.

speaker: hired_men
text: I am for the eggs only with my eyes, Master Shakespeare. The ling is what I was given, and the ling is what a hired man eats when the ordinary is sixpence and the company is paying its own plate. I am not a sharer. I am a witness with an appetite.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: And a witness may finish his plate without describing the other bank a second time. I have heard fair and restless. I do not need it in rhyme. More ale is sixpence more, if any of you are celebrating, and I do not think you are.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We are not celebrating. We are fed. Mistress Tipping, the eggs were the right mercy. Master Raye, the road north is enough. Dick, come out of the king before you bless the salt. I am going home to a page that is not a playhouse, and the page will not shout.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I will come out of him before the salt, since thou ask it in front of a witness. God keep thee. Do not write the girl a longer apology than the yard deserves. Yesterday taught me the value of a short quiet, and I am loth to see thee spend it on a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The apology is already struck. She has fewer words than she had last week. That is the work of the morning, and the eggs have not changed it. God keep thee. Pay the woman sooner than a king would.
